agent.reasons: Beneficial ownership is incomplete. Granite Holdings LLC holds 44%, nobody knows who owns it, and nothing shows it is an excluded entity. Another 30% has no named holder at all. Either block could hide an unidentified person with 20% or more, so SOP 3.3 says request documents. Everything else is clear. Control person Mateo Weiss (CEO, 26%) is ID-verified, with no sanctions match, no PEP status and no adverse media. The registry filing is from 2026-01-15, less than 12 months old. The entity is in the US, sanctions-clear and in a normal industry. No section calls for a more severe outcome.
still_needed: Ownership breakdown of Granite Holdings LLC down to individuals, or proof that it is an excluded entity under 31 CFR 1010.230(e)(2)
Who holds the unaccounted 30% of the entity
Identity verification and screening (sanctions, PEP, adverse media, geography) for any individual who turns out to own 20% or more
A record of the adverse media searches already run (terms, date, sources) under SOP 4.4
